records.title: BAR sizes from 1 GiB through 64 GiB produce profile-consistent placement or rejection
records.blocker: The product lacks a versioned full-tree MMIO planner and admission API that returns exact profile-specific placement or failure reasons.

records.title: Aggregate BAR demand and alignment produce correct bridge and root windows
records.blocker: Only root-level premises exist; recursive bridge packing, alignment, containment and product golden outputs are not implemented.

records.title: Firmware-only and host-hole-only large-BAR configurations fail closed
records.blocker: The product resolver does not jointly pin firmware aperture and QEMU host window or reject either incomplete configuration before launch.

records.title: SeaBIOS profile has independent below-4G, ROM, count and large-BAR limits
records.blocker: The product profile resolver and post-boot verifier do not independently enforce every SeaBIOS resource and ROM constraint.

records.title: RMRR compatibility creates an exact hole or an exact denial
records.blocker: Synthetic observations exist, but the product memory planner does not consume authoritative reserved regions and emit deterministic compatible/overlap results.

records.title: Expansion ROM is hidden by default and explicit ROM is hash-pinned
records.blocker: The product profile, signer and launcher do not yet enforce rombar-off by default or an explicit ROM hash and marker contract.

records.title: AER correctable and nonfatal events follow the selected host and guest surface policy
records.blocker: The versioned product QEMU profile and paired host/guest AER observation runner are not implemented.

records.title: PME and _OSC ownership produce the qualified interrupt behavior
records.blocker: The product ACPI/QEMU profile and controlled PME injection runner do not establish host versus guest ownership and IRQ behavior.

records.title: MSI-X, MSI and qualified INTx operate with interrupt remapping
records.blocker: Final interrupt-remapping, vector and shared-line INTx behavior requires a qualified bare-metal platform and physical device; nested MSI observations cannot close it.

records.title: ATS, PRI and PASID stay hidden unless an advanced profile is fully qualified
records.blocker: The default capability filter, optional advanced profile and complete invalidate/reset/teardown path are not implemented; hardware qualification alone would not fix this software gap.

records.title: Peer-to-peer DMA is denied unless the exact backend profile supports it
records.blocker: The product backend profile and admission path do not yet provide a non-bypassable default P2P denial or a qualified allow path.

records.title: Guest ReBAR writes cannot change the admitted BAR plan
records.blocker: The product QEMU profile and raw-launch bypass gate do not yet filter or make the effective ReBAR size immutable.

records.title: Verified device-count ceiling passes at the limit and rejects limit plus one
records.blocker: The final effective ceiling and locality/performance envelope require the exact supported bare-metal platform, firmware, device population and workload at limit and limit plus one.

records.title: Physical RMRR identity mapping preserves reserved pages and post-reset DMA
records.blocker: The final identity-mapping, guest-hole and reset-DMA result requires physical firmware RMRR and a qualified DMA-capable device; synthetic DMAR is insufficient.

records.title: Firmware and motherboard layout matrix accepts three valid combinations and rejects acpi plus bios
records.blocker: Reference observations exist, but the Qman create API, schema and launcher do not enforce one stable resolved layout and the invalid-combination negative gate.

records.title: Create and direct-register paths persist the same resolved layout provenance
records.blocker: The product does not persist requested and resolved layout plus resolver provenance across create, register and power-cycle paths.

records.title: Seven QEMU firmware and topology profiles are asserted through the product launcher
records.blocker: The lab matrix passes, but no product resolver, launcher and evidence collector reproduces the seven profile assertions.

records.title: Strict VMware guest machine ABI is either custom-implemented or explicitly rejected
records.blocker: Stock QEMU cannot satisfy the strict topology contract, and Qman has neither a custom machine implementation nor a product negative gate for this profile.

records.title: Exact-hole plus auxiliary demand rejects 2 GiB and succeeds at 4 GiB
records.blocker: The product planner lacks the full-tree exact-hole fixture and recursive bridge containment proof.

records.title: Exact MMIO solver succeeds where first-fit or greedy placement fails
records.blocker: The production planner has no bounded exact placement solver or deterministic greedy-failure regression.

records.title: Exact solver timeout fails closed without greedy fallback
records.blocker: No product solver deadline, stable MMIO_PLANNER_TIMEOUT result or test proving fallback placement is impossible exists.

records.title: Observed BAR or window drift prevents VM commit and invalidates the backend profile
records.blocker: The product lacks a post-boot BAR/window observer and rollback transaction that invalidates the exact backend profile before assignment commit.

records.title: Q35 SeaBIOS dual-64-GiB BAR floor matrix is reproduced by the product profile
records.blocker: Reference QEMU observations exist, but the product resolver, launcher and runtime-window verifier do not reproduce the floor matrix.

records.title: Q35 OVMF dual-64-GiB BAR aperture is explicitly provisioned and observed
records.blocker: The product path does not pin matching fw_cfg aperture and QEMU floor values or verify both BARs and guest heartbeat after launch.
